title: The action is a completion of continuity, not its origin

statements.text: Many inequivalent variational completions return the same continuity equation while giving different downstream dynamics, so an action represents and completes the primitive law rather than being its unique source.

sources.quote: A family of inequivalent variational completions returns the same continuity equation while producing different descendant dynamics. As such, the action is a representation and completion of the primitive, not its unique origin.
